units.source_text: 还飨设在正殿的南厢中，照例请优胜一方的中少将朝南坐。

en.t: The return banquet was set up in the south wing of the main hall, and as usual the Middle Captain from the winning side was invited to sit facing south.

units.source_text: 做陪客的诸亲皇及公卿朝北坐，和他们相对。

en.t: The princes and courtiers serving as accompanying guests sat facing north, opposite them.

units.source_text: 正在兴酣之时，将监们开始表演《求子》舞。

en.t: Just as the merriment was at its height, the Guards officers began to perform the Motomego dance.

units.source_text: 庭中梅花盛开，附近几株梅花的香气被舞袖的回风扇动，流散满座。

en.t: Plum blossoms were in full bloom in the garden, and the scent from several nearby trees was stirred by the returning breeze of the dancers' sleeves and spread through the whole gathering.

units.source_text: 但薰中将身上的香气更胜于梅花，馥郁不可言喻。

en.t: But the fragrance about Captain Kaoru surpassed even the plum blossoms, rich beyond words.

units.source_text: 众侍女隔帘偷窥薰中将，说道：

en.t: The ladies in waiting peeped at Captain Kaoru from behind the blinds and said,

units.source_text: “可惜天光太暗，相貌看不清楚。

en.t: It is a pity the light is so dim that we cannot see his face clearly.

units.source_text: 但这香气确是无人比得上的。”

en.t: But surely no one can compare with this fragrance.
Everyone praised him to the utmost.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣也觉得此人的确不凡。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, also felt that this man was truly extraordinary.

units.source_text: 他看见薰中将今天相貌和仪态比平常更加优美，斯文一脉地坐着，便对他说：

en.t: Seeing that Captain Kaoru's looks and bearing were even more graceful than usual today, and that he sat with quiet refinement, he said to him,

units.source_text: “右中将啊！你也来一起唱吧！不要做客人呀！”

en.t: Captain of the Right, you should sing with us too. Do not sit there like a guest.

units.source_text: 薰中将便恰到好处地唱了一段“天国的神座上”。

en.t: Captain Kaoru then sang, at just the right moment, a passage beginning On the divine seat of heaven.
